content.title: EXCLUSIVE: zSpace Expands Global Reach With New AR/VR Laptop Launch
content.summary: Augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR) learning solutions provider zSpace, Inc. (NASDAQ:ZSPC) on Thursday announced the international availability of the zSpace Inspire 2 Laptop. The launch took place at the GESS Dubai 2025 Conference, held from November 11 to 13 at the Dubai World Trade Centre. The company will highlight its latest immersive learning innovations designed to make AR and VR accessible, engaging, and effective for learners of all ages—without the need for headsets.
